def is_narcissistic_in_base(n, b):
    digits = [0] if n == 0 else []
    x = n

        x //= b
    k = len(digits)

        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in s)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in s)

            m += 12
            y -= 1

        J = y // 100
